history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Asian man with dark, messy hair is taking a selfie with his phone, which is reflected on a computer screen. He is looking directly at the phone's camera, with his left hand touching his cheek and his right hand holding the phone. His mouth is slightly open, as if he's about to speak or make a funny face. The phone has a distinctive triple-camera setup, with purple-tinted lenses.

The computer screen displays a webcam interface with various controls. A pink button with the text "Normal" is prominently visible, along with navigation arrows and a gear icon for settings. In the background, on the computer screen, there are several small ad banners showing laptops with "OFF" discounts, suggesting an online shopping context. The overall lighting is dim, with a blueish glow emanating from the computer screen and reflecting on the man's face and the background. The mood is casual and playful, with a hint of a modern, tech-savvy aesthetic. The color palette is dominated by dark tones, contrasted with the bright pink and purple elements of the interface and phone.
